snippet.title: The Last Warning
snippet.description:
Welcome to The Last Warning. 

I'm John — and I make videos about how our planet, the cosmosactually work: extreme weather, earthquakes, volcanoes, oceans, space, and the discoveries that changed how we understand the world. Every video on this channel is a one-man production: script, visuals, audio, and editing all done by me, using Final Cut, Affinity Photo, Audacity, and Photoshop.

This is where you'll be the first to know about the phenomena unfolding right now — often before you hear about them anywhere else.
Thank you for stopping by and being part of this. If you're curious about the planet, the cosmos, and the events shaping both, you're exactly who I made this for.

snippet.title: The People Profiles
snippet.description:
Established in 2018 by Edwin Elliott, The People Profiles was the first long-form independent documentary channel on YouTube. With detailed, politically neutral, meticulously researched scripts, all written by qualified and award-winning historians, narrators and video editors with years of experience in both video production and film. The team at The People Profiles prides itself on being the gold standard for attention to detail, accuracy, quality, as well as unbiased, fair and factual biographies of famous and infamous people in history.

As of 2026, all People Profiles scripts are written, narrated and edited by human beings and our thumbnails are based on real paintings, statues and photographs of each historical figure, to give you the most accurate image of them possible. 

"All human history essentially comes down to biography." Edwin Elliott

snippet.title: History Theology
snippet.description:
"God loves Knowledge. Wisdom and Understanding."
The Damascus Document, The Dead Sea Scrolls 

“I sit with Shakespeare, and he winces not. Across the color line I move arm and arm with Balzac and Dumas, where smiling men and welcoming women glide in gilded halls. From out of the caves of evening that swing between the strong-limbed Earth and the tracery of stars, I summon Aristotle and Aurelius and what soul I will, and they come all graciously with no scorn nor condescension. So, wed with Truth, I dwell above the veil."
W.E.B. Du Bois


“Wretched men cringe before tyrants who have no power, the victims of their trivial hopes and fears. They do not realize that anger is hopeless, fear is pointless and desire all a delusion. 
One's virtue is all that one truly has, because it is not imperiled by the vicissitudes of fortune.”
― Boethius 

"Each moment free from fear is immortality" 
Mary Renault on Alexander

snippet.title: Origins OSU
snippet.description:
"Origins: Current Events in Historical Perspective" connects history with today. Every month since 2007 on our web site at origins.osu.edu, we’ve provided historical insight on current events that matter to the United States & the world. In 2016 we launched this channel to share videos based on written features from our web site as well as webinars. Origins: Current Events in Historical Perspective is a collaboration between the history departments of Ohio State University in Columbus and Miami University in Oxford, Ohio. 

We hope that Origins will help you understand the world more fully. To provide the best and most interesting content, we have and continue to partner with other like-minded organizations.

The final goal of Origins is to make us all more informed, engaged citizens. As the American philosopher John Dewey wrote, “History which is not brought down close to the actual scene of events leaves a gap.”
